_comment: Apps the hub offers. pack-apps zips each one into a verified package and writes the catalog.
hubNotes: The hub now shows its own version in the top bar, and app versions are labelled by app (for example "Studio 1.0.0"), so an app's version is never mistaken for the hub's. Updating from 1.0.0 or 1.0.1 shows the setup wizard one last time: click Next through it.

apps.name: Saw Forge Studio
apps.description: Arrange, record and mix with the Saw Forge wavetable synth, Worship Atmospheres pads, virtual EDM drummers, take comping and automation.
apps.notes: First desktop release: Saw Forge synth, Worship Atmospheres with Live Pad Mode and setlists, Drummer, recording with take lanes and comping, automation, WAV export.

comingSoon.name: More Saw Forge apps
comingSoon.description: New instruments and tools will appear here and install with one click.
